caption:
Google just turned your post stats back on.

Open the Posts tab in your Google Business Profile dashboard. Every post from the last 18 months now shows a view count, Search and Maps combined into one number.

A view count shows attention. It does not show who called, who booked, or who paid. Google pulled this same metric in 2023 for that exact reason.

This week: post three different offers and compare the view counts. Then track what actually happens after each view.

A view isn't a job. Speed turns it into one. See every call, text, and booked job behind your views in one pipeline, 14 days free, no card.

DM TRIAL

#GoogleBusinessProfile #LocalServiceMarketing #SpeedToLead #ServiceBusinessMarketing #LeadFollowUp
rationale: News reels win cold-audience reach, and Google's just-confirmed Post view counts (live Oct 5, 2026) is a fresh, verifiable, unclaimed GBP angle interpreted honestly as a visibility-not-conversion metric, bridged to the platform's pipeline tracking.
